pli-tv-bi-vb-pc29:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc29:1.2: tena kho pana samayena thullanandāya bhikkhuniyā upaṭṭhākakulaṃ thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc29:1.3: sace mayaṃ ayye sakkoma bhikkhunīsaṅghassa cīvaraṃ dassāmāti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc29:1.4: tena kho pana samayena vassaṃ vutthā bhikkhuniyo cīvaraṃ bhājetukāmā sannipatiṃsu.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc29:1.9: thullanandā bhikkhunī yena taṃ kulaṃ tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā te manusse etadavoca
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc29:1.11: na mayaṃ ayye sakkoma bhikkhunīsaṅghassa cīvaraṃ dātunti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc29:1.13: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc29:1.14: kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā thullanandā dubbalacīvarapaccāsāya cīvarakālasamayaṃ atikkāmessatīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc29:1.15: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī dubbalacīvarapaccāsāya cīvarakālasamayaṃ atikkāmetīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc29:1.18: hi nāma bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī dubbalacīvarapaccāsāya cīvarakālasamayaṃ atikkāmessati
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc29:1.20: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc29:1.21.1: yā pana bhikkhunī dubbalacīvarapaccāsāya cīvarakālasamayaṃ atikkāmeyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc29:2.1.6: sace mayaṃ sakkoma dassāma karissāmāti vācā bhinnā hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc29:2.1.8: anatthate kaṭhine vassānassa pacchimo māso atthate kaṭhine pañca māsā.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc29:2.1.10: anatthate kaṭhine vassānassa pacchimaṃ divasaṃ atikkāmeti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc29:2.1.11: atthate kaṭhine kaṭhinuddhāradivasaṃ atikkāmeti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc29:2.2.1: dubbalacīvare dubbalacīvarasaññā cīvarakālasamayaṃ atikkāmeti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc29:2.2.2: dubbalacīvare vematikā cīvarakālasamayaṃ atikkāmeti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
